name: Glowverse
subtitle: AI Beauty & AR Try-On
description:
Transform your beauty shopping with Glowverse – the ultimate AI-powered beauty platform combining virtual try-on, personalized skin analysis, and seamless shopping.

KEY FEATURES

AR VIRTUAL TRY-ON
Try any makeup product virtually before you buy using advanced augmented reality technology.

AI SKIN ANALYSIS
Get personalized skincare recommendations powered by AI.

SEAMLESS SHOPPING
Browse thousands of beauty products from top brands.

EASY ORDER TRACKING
Track your orders in real-time with push notifications.
